title: fix: Polli states what it couldn't verify about Discord channels
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Polli’s Discord search prompt now treats search results and visible messages as a partial view, not the full conversation. It instructs Polli to fetch relevant channel or thread history when possible and state what it could not verify otherwise.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art Discord reading nook, Polli wears tiny librarian glasses and compares a few message cards with a longer thread beside a glowing CRT monitor and potted code-plants. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
